'''Sealbreaker''' is the title given to [[Logain Ablar]] by his bonded [[Aes Sedai]], [[Gabrelle Brawley]], as she urges him to destroy the seals in preparation for the resealing of the [[Bore]] by [[Rand al'Thor]] during the [[Last Battle]].

{{quote|Light bathed them.
He stopped. That beam of light to the north... channeling like none he’d ever felt before, not even at the cleansing. Such ''power''.
“It’s happening,” Gabrelle said, stepping up to him.
Logain reached to his belt, then took three items from his pouch. Discs, half white, half black. The nearby [[Asha’man]] turned toward him, pausing in [[Healing]] and comforting the people.
“Do it,” Gabrelle said. “Do it, ''Sealbreaker''.”
Logain snapped the once unbreakable [[seals]], one by one, and dropped the pieces to the ground.|{{14|48}}}}

The gaining of this title is almost certainly a partial fulfillment of various [[Min's viewings#Logain|viewings]] by [[Min Farshaw]] concerning Logain.
